name: Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic
summary: In Stormwind, High Sorcerer Andromath seeks the forbidden tome Morganth stole and carried to the Tower of Ilgalar in the Redridge Mountains.

sections.title: A Schism in the Tower
sections.body: Three promising mages once studied together in Stormwind's Wizard's Sanctum. Morganth turned to dark arts and shadow magic, despite his peers' desperate warnings to abandon those corrupting powers. The city's magical order formally banished him. Before leaving, he stole a dangerous work by Ur, an infamous archmage whose studies reached beyond orthodox arcana.

sections.title: The Fallen Mage's Lair
sections.body: Morganth seized the Tower of Ilgalar in the heights of the Redridge Mountains, far from Stormwind's scrutiny. High Sorcerer Andromath considers the tome's knowledge hazardous in the hands of an outcast practicing forbidden sorcery. He sends Alliance adventurers to breach the tower and recover it before its wards fall.

sections.title: Intact Wards
sections.body: After the treatise is recovered from Ilgalar's library and returned to the Wizard's Sanctum, High Sorcerer Andromath is greatly relieved. He feared Morganth had already unraveled its protective enchantments or hidden the book beyond reach. The magical seals on Ur's treatise held firm, keeping the catastrophic secrets in its pages from the rogue sorcerer.

faq.answer: Ur wrote the treatise. The legendary Dalaran mage was renowned for esoteric research into extra-planar entities and shadow magic.

faq.q: Who stole Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic?
faq.answer: Morganth stole Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic. He was a Stormwind mage who fell to dark magic and was banished from the Wizard's Sanctum.
The book is in the library of the Tower of Ilgalar, high in the Redridge Mountains, where Morganth established his new sanctuary.

faq.q: Did Morganth manage to read the book?
faq.answer: No. High Sorcerer Andromath confirms that the book's protective seals held firm when it was returned, so Morganth never opened it.

faq.q: Why do the mages of Stormwind want the book back?
faq.answer: The tome holds profound secrets of shadow magic that can bring ruin to the untrained. Stormwind's mages consider it too perilous to leave with Morganth, an outcast practicing forbidden sorcery.

aliases: where to get urs treatise quest
faq.answer: High Sorcerer Andromath offers it from the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

angles.text: As a mage, you see Stormwind's mages take internal discipline seriously. They entrust practitioners with containing the danger left by a peer who turned to forbidden shadow magic.
As a warlock, you may covet the powers of extra-planar summoning and dark casting sealed in Ur's treatises, though the Kirin Tor and Stormwind's mages fear them.
As an Alliance member, you help protect Redridge from Morganth's growing magical menace and Stormwind from rogue arcana by recovering the stolen tome.
